evals.prompt:
here's the label text for our 6ml roll-on, can you check it before the designer finalises?

NAFHAAR — Royal Oud
Pure Arabian Attar · Made in Dubai
100% Halal · Alcohol Free · Lasts 24 hrs
Inspired by Tom Ford Oud Wood
Price: Rs 999
www.nafhaar.in
evals.expected_output: A table flagging missing mandatory items (actual manufacturer + M.L. No., Marketed by, net quantity, MRP incl. taxes, mfg/use-before date, consumer care, origin line) and risky claims (Made in Dubai, halal, 24 hrs, Tom Ford reference, 'Pure'/'Royal Oud' composition), with a corrected label.
expectations: Flags missing actual manufacturer name/address and manufacturing licence number (M.L. No.)
Flags missing net quantity, MRP 'incl. of all taxes', mfg/expiry date and consumer-care contact
Flags 'Made in Dubai' and supplies the 'Made in India; fragrance oil imported from UAE' origin line
Flags '100% Halal' as a high-risk claim
Flags 'Lasts 24 hrs' as needing substantiation
Flags 'Inspired by Tom Ford Oud Wood' as a trademark/passing-off risk
Questions 'Pure Arabian Attar'/'Royal Oud' composition claims
Provides a corrected label text

evals.prompt: we got 5 LOIs! what exactly do we file now and in what order to legally import our first 20kg of oil from the sharjah factory and get it filled at a chennai filler? give me forms, fees, timelines and what needs verifying
evals.expected_output: Ordered steps: loan licence COS-6->COS-9 with the filler (category 41, ~Rs10k, ~45 days + inspection) in parallel with CDSCO COS-1->COS-2 (Rule 12(4) bulk needs Indian licence details; manufacturer authorisation authenticated; fees per category/site/variant to verify; up to 6 months), Legal Metrology importer registration, IEC/GST prerequisites, SDS flash point/shelf life, duty ~31% to verify with broker; clear verify flags.
expectations: Says the loan licence (COS-6 -> COS-9) with the filler is needed and that the filler's licence must cover category 41
Explains CDSCO import registration COS-1 -> COS-2 is required for the bulk oil and that the application needs the Indian (loan) licence details
Mentions the manufacturer authorisation letter must be authenticated (apostille/embassy/consulate)
Gives fee and timeline figures and marks the ones that need verification
Includes Legal Metrology importer registration
Mentions SDS flash point / dangerous-goods and shelf-life (>= 6 months) requirements for the shipment
Presents the steps in a sensible order with dependencies

evals.prompt: draft instagram caption for our launch reel: 'Dubai's best kept secret is finally in India 🇦🇪➡️🇮🇳 our oils are made for the desert so they last all day in chennai heat. better than ajmal at half the price. relieves stress too. #halal #attar #dubaiperfume'. is this ok to post? fix it
evals.expected_output: Flags 'Dubai's best kept secret'/origin framing, desert/all-day longevity claim, comparative claim vs Ajmal, therapeutic 'relieves stress', #halal; provides a compliant, still punchy caption.
expectations: Flags the 'relieves stress' therapeutic claim
Flags the comparative claim 'better than Ajmal'
Flags the desert / last-all-day longevity claim
Flags #halal
Flags the Dubai-origin framing / #dubaiperfume as misleading for an India-filled product
Provides a rewritten caption that keeps it engaging without the risky claims
